events.address: The Rink at Rockefeller Center, 45 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: A public big-screen viewing hub for live and recorded New York Fashion Week runway shows at The Rink.
events.what_is_free: Free public viewing of participating NYFW runway shows on the Rockefeller Center screen.
events.caveats: The official page confirms September 10–15 and says the viewing experience is completely free and open to the public. Individual runway-show times follow the published NYFW Live schedule and can vary by day.
events.practical_notes: No RSVP requirement is published for the public viewing area. Check the official daily lineup for the specific designers you want to watch.

events.address: Channel Gardens, 45 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: A three-day public GapBags pop-up for the new Five-Pocket Tote with on-site personalization, charms and limited artist-designed drops.
events.what_is_free: Admission to browse the pop-up is free. Bags, charms and merchandise are retail products unless otherwise stated on site.
events.caveats: Official Rockefeller Center information says the pop-up is open to the public September 11–13 from 10 AM–6 PM daily. Limited-edition artist drops may be quantity-limited.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public shopping activation; no RSVP requirement is published.

events.what_it_is: Renggli's first pop-up, presented with Vivrelle, pairing the Renggli Fall 2026 collection with Vivrelle designer handbags and jewelry.
events.what_is_free: Free public access to browse the pop-up; merchandise and Vivrelle products are for sale or available under Vivrelle's normal membership model.
events.caveats: Vivrelle's site and its release confirm the September 10–13 SoHo pop-up; a current event listing explicitly describes it as open to the public.
events.practical_notes: Open 11 AM–7 PM each day. No RSVP requirement is established in the verified sources.

events.address: Felix Roasting Co., 145 Greene St, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A one-day school-drop-off-themed launch event for Stitch Fix's Favorite Daughter collaboration with styling, coffee, breakfast and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Coffee/breakfast and promotional giveaways are advertised, including AM To Go Kit goodies and gift-card giveaways; inventory and winning are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Current event listings describe the September 10 event as open to the public. Giveaway quantities and gift-card wins are not guaranteed.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 10 from 9 AM–4 PM. No RSVP or approval requirement is published in the current listings.

events.what_it_is: A six-room immersive exhibition by fashion photographer Szilveszter Makó exploring identity, folklore, memory and image-making.
events.what_is_free: Public exhibition access is free. The official host page says walk-ins are accepted first-come, first-served if public slots are unavailable.
events.caveats: The host offers bookable public slots, but explicitly says walk-ins will be accepted on the day on a first-come, first-served basis if public slots are unavailable. Separate Capital One cardholder events are not the same as the public exhibition.
events.practical_notes: Treat booking as helpful but not mandatory for the public exhibition; same-day walk-in access remains capacity-dependent.

events.what_it_is: Opening day for BEAUTYSPACE's Little Luxuries store, focused on mini and travel-size beauty products with an opening-day giveaway and free claw-machine play after email signup.
events.what_is_free: No purchase is required to enter the opening-day suitcase giveaway or sign up to play the Little Luxuries claw machine for a chance at beauty prizes.
events.caveats: Entry is open to the public. Giveaway participation requires email signup, and prizes are chance-based rather than guaranteed. Sources conflict on opening time: BEAUTYSPACE's release says the store is open daily from 9 AM, while NYC for FREE lists the event from 10 AM; the official company release is used for store hours.
events.practical_notes: Open September 10 from 9 AM–8 PM based on BEAUTYSPACE's own release. No advance RSVP is required.

events.event_name: KAY Jewelers Love All In Mobile Pop-Up
events.address: Multiple Manhattan stops; see each dated occurrence
events.what_it_is: A mobile jewelry-box-themed confessional activation with Love/Dare mini-games, a selfie station, bedazzled photo strips and a diamond sweepstakes entry opportunity.
events.what_is_free: Free participation in the public activation and a stylized bedazzled photo strip. Diamond sweepstakes entry is chance-based and not a guaranteed prize.
events.caveats: Current listings describe the activation as free and open to the public. It has different Manhattan locations on September 10 and September 12, so use the date-specific occurrence details rather than the general event address.
events.practical_notes: September 10 is at the Starrett-Lehigh Building area, 26th Street and 11th Avenue, 6:30–8:30 PM. September 12 is on West Broadway between Prince and Spring, 11 AM–8 PM.
